current_heading.text: Почему этот риск не видно заранее

nearest_text_before.text: продавец уклоняется от вопросов о финансовой ситуации.

image_reading: A cropped man stands by a stair railing, holding an open, nearly empty black wallet and a few coins in his other palm.
The wallet, coins, and hands are central and remain clearly visible; the background is softly blurred.
The body is already still, so a restrained hand-and-coin movement can express financial strain without introducing new events.
analysis.article_context: Cover image for an article about the hidden bankruptcy risk in resale-home purchases: it foregrounds the prospect of losing money and conveys financial vulnerability before the article explains the legal mechanism.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation makes the article’s warning tangible: an apparently ordinary property deal can leave the buyer facing a serious financial loss.
structured_intent.primary_action: The man slowly tilts the open wallet toward the few coins in his palm.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The open wallet is visibly empty beside the few coins, which have settled in his palm.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Financial vulnerability and insufficiency remain evident throughout.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, he makes one restrained, deliberate tilt of the open wallet toward the coins in his palm. The coins slide slightly together and settle by the end while the wallet stays visibly empty and open. Use a fixed camera centered on the wallet and hand; the motion develops evenly and tapers naturally in the final moments.
models.positive_prompt: The man slowly tilts his open wallet toward his palm; the few coins shift and settle together in his hand, ending with the empty wallet held open beside the small pile of coins. Fixed camera.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, the man slowly rotates the open wallet toward the coin-filled palm in one continuous gesture. The coins make a small natural shift and settle near the end, underscoring the contrast between them and the empty wallet. Keep the camera fixed on the hands and wallet; finish on the held, clearly empty wallet without a second action.
models.positive_prompt: He gradually turns the open empty wallet toward the few coins in his palm; the coins gather and come to rest, with the wallet still visibly empty in the final frame. Fixed camera.

models.scene_plan: Across four seconds, use a compact, steady wallet tilt toward the palm as the single action. Let the few coins shift into a small cluster and settle close to the end, while the open wallet remains in view and recognizably empty. The fixed close framing holds attention on the financial shortfall through the final frame.
models.positive_prompt: The subject gently angles the open wallet toward the few coins in his palm; the coins slide together and settle, ending on the clearly empty wallet and the small cluster of coins. Fixed camera.
